name: @adr/spine
//private: THE VENDORED TEMPLATE, packaged internally for the wall and never published. `private: true` with no publishConfig anywhere is what makes template-forever structural instead of a promise. No `version` field either: npm does not require one on a private workspace package, and release numbering belongs to the CHANGELOG decision rather than to this file.
//exports: One subpath pattern per tier, so a consumer names the tier it depends on and an unlisted path is a resolution error. WHICH tier a given folder may name is still the import table's job, because an exports map cannot vary by consumer: it cannot let the root see `boundary` while denying it to a block.
